resources.string: Paragraphs
Copy that is read rather than scanned.
A paragraph fills each line before it wraps. Words are never hyphenated, and earlier lines are not shortened to balance the last one, so the line ends stay as even as the words allow.
识别在本机完成，屏幕上的内容不会上传；截图只保留在内存里，用完即弃。逗号、顿号、句号都跟着前一个字，不会落到下一行的开头。
Protected
Plain
Closing punctuation is tied to the character before it, so no line starts with a mark.
Protection is off. Where a mark falls at a line break is left to the platform.
Callouts
A note beside running text, in four tones.
What stays on the device
Recognition runs locally. Nothing on the screen is uploaded.
Permission granted
The overlay can now be drawn above other apps.
Battery saver is on
The system may pause the service while the screen is off.
This cannot be undone
Clearing the history removes every saved result.

All four notes are set to ink
Flow row

Read
On the device
Answer

Media frame
A picture set into a recessed well.
Three hills under a low sun
Drawn in code from the theme colours. The frame keeps the chosen shape at any width.
Without a picture the well shows a muted icon, which also serves while an image loads.

The paragraph rules, the callout bar, the flow row and the recessed media well were extracted from the original app. Callout tones, right-to-left support, the aspect ratio and the empty frame were designed for Sancai.
